parameters.name: AuditAccountName
parameters.description: The name of the audit administrator account. > This parameter is required if the three-role mode is enabled. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

parameters.name: AuditAccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the audit administrator account. > This parameter is required if the three-role mode is enabled. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance resides. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.
